title: We need a €2 million investment to open a second assembly hall, and our bank wants a three-year cash-flow model with sensitivity analysis that our CFO doesn't have the capacity to prepare before the Q3 deadline.

record.text: We need a €2 million investment to open a second assembly hall, and our bank wants a three-year cash-flow model with sensitivity analysis that our CFO doesn't have the capacity to prepare before the Q3 deadline.
record.detail: We have planning permission and a cleared site adjacent to our existing building for a second assembly hall, which would let us run two large projects in parallel and cut our delivery lead times significantly. The total investment is around €2 million covering the building shell, electrical infrastructure, and a new overhead crane. We have a bank that is willing to discuss the loan but their condition before they will issue a term sheet is a three-year cash-flow model with sensitivity analysis showing how the business performs under different revenue and cost scenarios. Our CFO, Milena Varga, manages day-to-day financial operations well, but building a robust forward-looking model of this kind is outside what she normally does, and she does not have the time to learn it from scratch before the bank's Q3 deadline, which falls at the end of September 2024. We have the historical financial data — five years of audited accounts, project margin records, and a pipeline of signed and probable orders. We need someone who can structure that data into a credible model and help Milena understand it well enough to present it and answer questions from the bank.
